BACHELOR'S RULE

12-Year Schooling & ESSLCE Requirement

Italian universities require 12 years of schooling plus the ESSLCE certificate legalized at EAES & MoFA Kazanchis, plus TOLC or SAT. Primary full-funding route: Regional DSU Need-Based Scholarship.

Ethiopian & Italian Official Glossary

Essential terms for Addis Ababa offices and Italian university calls

1. Dichiarazione di Valore (DoV) — የትምህርት ማስረጃ ግምገማ

Official certificate issued by the Consular Office of the Italian Embassy in Addis Ababa (Villa Italia, Kebena) confirming your ESSLCE or Bachelor's degree is valid for Italian university enrollment.

2. ISEE Parificato — የቤተሰብ ገቢ እና ንብረት ምዘና

Equivalent Economic Situation Indicator calculated by an Italian CAF office using your MoFA-legalized and Italian-translated Kebele Family Composition, Parents' Income/Tax Certificate, and Housing status.

3. FDRE Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MoFA) — የኢ.ፌ.ዲ.ሪ. ውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስቴር (ካዛንቺስ)

Located in Kazanchis, Addis Ababa. Every Ethiopian academic and financial/Kebele document must carry the MoFA authentication stamp before Italian translation and Embassy legalization.

4. EAES & Education and Training Authority (ETA / HERQA)

EAES (Arat Kilo) verifies Grade 12 ESSLCE national exam certificates; ETA/HERQA & Ministry of Education authenticate higher education degrees from Ethiopian universities.

5. Bando di Concorso & Idoneo vs. Beneficiario

Bando is the official scholarship call. Idoneo means eligible (tuition waiver + canteen access); Beneficiario means funded winner receiving the cash stipend.
